collective_criteria.check: Viewed together at 1x and 3x in one 32x32 cell each, the four facings share the same robot: equal height and ground line, the same navy frame/teal body/pale-yellow eye colours, consistent antenna posts, and a box volume that turns coherently S->E->N->W without a facing looking like a different object or size.
collective_criteria.basis: Brief identity/proportions/palette; PLAR delivery check 'identity, volume and alignment together'.

collective_criteria.check: Each file at the controller path spriteFor(facing) shows that facing: south front, east right, north back, west left.
collective_criteria.basis: src/robot.ts mapping; brief 'Keep direction labels aligned with the controller'.

collective_criteria.check: renderer-native/check.py reports pass for the capture made from the delivered files with the unchanged controller (all four facings mapped, 32x32 RGBA transparent, south bytes identical, screenshot pixels match).
collective_criteria.basis: CF-10: run the copied renderer and save exact returned reports; renderer README contract.

collective_criteria.check: destination.png and every 1x/3x cell of the capture, viewed with the image tool, show the four facings rendered crisply (nearest), transparent over the observation background, without resampling blur, cropping or misplacement.
collective_criteria.basis: CF-10: inspect destination.png and all actual 1x/3x cells; acceptance requires actual visual judgment.

note: Engine-domain criteria must be live mode in PX2; the visual renderer inspection will be authored as a visual-mode 'other'/'continuity' criterion if the validator refuses engine+visual, keeping the obligation.
